Idempotency-Replayed.description: `true` when this response is the stored answer of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key; never present on the first execution.

Location.description: Path of the newly created Site.

schema.description: A physical facility/building — the root of the location hierarchy.

siteCode.description: Uppercase alphanumeric code, unique across the service.

status.description: The lifecycle state shared by every structural aggregate. Decommission is one-way in v1. UnderMaintenance is a legal persisted state that the read models render; no v1 use case sets it.
status.title: Status

siteRole.description: The site's role in the fulfilment network (ADR-0037). `UNSPECIFIED` means nobody classified the site yet; it is the registration default and cannot be assigned by `PUT /sites/{siteCode}/role`.
siteRole.title: SiteRole

gln.description: A GS1 Global Location Number (ADR-0045): 13 digits whose last digit is the GS1 mod-10 check digit of the first twelve (weights 3 and 1, alternating from the right). The pattern only checks the shape; the check digit is verified by the service (422 `invalid-gln`). A GLN identifies exactly one site, zone or slot (409 `gln-already-assigned`). Optional everywhere; omitted when none was recorded.
gln.title: Gln

schema.title: Site

400.description: Malformed input, or the Idempotency-Key header is absent (`idempotency-key-required`) or not 1-128 printable ASCII characters (`idempotency-key-invalid`) (ADR 0019).

409.description: A state conflict: a code already taken, a GS1 Global Location Number already assigned to another location (`gln-already-assigned`, ADR-0045), a parent that exists but is no longer Active, or a slot already decommissioned. On a POST it is also the answer to an Idempotency-Key reused with a different method, path or body (`idempotency-key-reused`); the problem type tells the two apart.
